intentComment: Story 072 - THE PROMOTION-READY CUTOVER. One differential mainnet broadcast promoting the accumulated nft-staking (9611312) / yield-claim-nft (9c18020) / stable-yield-accumulator (6eab35c) work. Five coupled changes: (1) deploy NudgeStreamer and convert every donor from 'push USDC at the batch-minter' to 'approve + collectNudge through the streamer'; (2) redeploy all four donor dispatchers - BalancerPoolerV2 (idx 4), Uniboost x3 (idx 1/2/3), NudgeRatchet (idx 7 replacing NudgeRatchetDelayRelease) - plus StableYieldAccumulator; (3) replace the shared BatchNFTMinter with BatchNFTMinterMultiToken, whitelist USDC/phUSD/Kendu and registerStream at 10/30/30 days; (4) silently migrate the three NFTStakerDepletion instances to NFTStakerDepletionV2 via NFTStakerMigrator; (5) retire the old batch minter (setPauser(OWNER) + pause()). THE FIVE MINT-DEBT HOOKS ARE REPOINTED, NOT REDEPLOYED, so there are ZERO phUSD.setMinter calls. Per index the order is pull() -> hook.setDispatcher(new) -> new.setHook(hook) -> replaceDispatcher(idx, new): fail-closed. PREREQUISITE: run promotion-ready:snapshot first. Owner 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6, Ledger HD m/44'/60'/46'/0/0.

orderingSemantics.meaning: short-circuit on non-zero exit. The patcher runs ONLY on a zero exit from forge script, so a failed or partial broadcast never writes addresses for contracts that may not exist.
orderingSemantics.riskIfSemicolon: ';' would patch mainnet-addresses.ts from a progress file describing a partially-landed broadcast. Documented explicitly in the //promotion-ready:broadcast annotation.
orderingSemantics.residualGap: '&&' guards against a NON-ZERO forge exit, not against a ZERO-exit run whose progress file still overstates what landed. The progress file is written during forge's LOCAL execution pass, BEFORE broadcasting (patcher header, lines 16-22); the patcher's deploymentStatus=='completed' gate is 'necessary but not sufficient' by its own admission, and the mitigation is a HUMAN hand-trim step.

riskyFlagSemantics.--broadcast: sends real transactions from the Ledger key 0xCad1a786...D0B6.
riskyFlagSemantics.--skip-simulation: skips the on-chain simulation of the collected transaction list. It does NOT skip the script's local execution pass - the Solidity body always executes locally first, so a revert in the body (e.g. a missing snapshot file) still aborts the whole run before any transaction is sent. What it removes is the pre-send sanity check that each queued tx would succeed against current chain state, which matters most here because Phase 4's ordering deliberately makes intermediate on-chain states where mints revert.
riskyFlagSemantics.--slow: sends one transaction per block and waits for each receipt. Consequence flagged by the script itself: each tx lands in a NEW block, so timestamp-dependent accrual (_updatePool, depositFor, mint-debt) does real SSTORE work the single-timestamp local pass never sees. This is the origin of BOTH the --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 need and the SWEEP_HEADROOM_BPS read-vs-replay hazard.
riskyFlagSemantics.--ledger --hd-paths m/44'/60'/46'/0/0: hardware signer; the session is long (order 60+ transactions) and manual. Every intermediate half-configured state (mints reverting on indices 1/2/3/4/7) persists for the whole session.
riskyFlagSemantics.--legacy: type-0 transactions with no maxFeePerGas field, so geth's 'maxFeePerGas below base fee' rejection cannot fire during a long --slow session (story-071 lesson). Cost: with --legacy the gas price is the FLAT PRICE PAID, not a cap.
riskyFlagSemantics.--with-gas-price 0.5gwei: the flat price paid per gas. Deliberately a small multiple of base fee; the annotation records that 2 gwei+ overpaid ~13x on the story-071 cutover. Underpricing risk is the mirror hazard: a 0.5 gwei legacy tx can stall if base fee rises mid-session.
riskyFlagSemantics.--gas-estimate-multiplier 200: raises the gas LIMIT to 200% of estimate (story-073 lesson: OutOfGas on the second depositFor under --slow with forge's default 130%). On mainnet with --legacy --with-gas-price, unused gas is refunded, so the cost is bounded.
riskyFlagSemantics.-vvv: verbosity; the console.log stream is the operator's mid-session runbook.

previewModeSemantics.true: vm.startPrank(OWNER) wraps phases 1-6; no progress file; _phase8_previewSmokeTests() runs
previewModeSemantics.false: vm.startBroadcast() wraps phases 1-6; _writeProgressFileWithStatus("completed"); Phase 8 NEVER runs
previewModeSemantics.consequence: the BLOCKING Kendu fee-on-transfer probe lives in Phase 8 and therefore never executes in a broadcast run. Kendu is whitelisted UNCONDITIONALLY in Phase 2. The gate is PROCEDURAL (operator must run :dry first), not structural - acknowledged in the story's Post-review correction #2 and in the patcher header.
